implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::mathematics_intent -> Intent::FiniteProbabilityStatistics -> math::finite_probability_statistics -> normalize_weight_values
supported_behavior_from_source: Japanese 「期待値 [outcomes] 重み [weights] を計算して」 / 「を計算してください」 and English `expected-value [outcomes] weights [weights]` parse two explicit flat exact-scalar arrays.
Each outcome is paired with one weight; both arrays must contain 1..4096 elements and have equal lengths. Outcomes may be negative; weights must be nonnegative with a positive exact total.
The existing exact weight-normalization implementation is shared. It verifies that normalized probabilities sum exactly to one.
Core computes expected value as the sum of outcome times normalized probability and variance as the probability-weighted squared deviation from that exact expected value.

The report retains original outcomes and weights, exact normalized probabilities, each aligned expected-value and variance contribution, total weight, exact probability sum, count, expected value and variance.

Extra trailing constraints are rejected by the finite parser; integer/rational representation and operation budgets remain bounded. The result describes the supplied distribution and does not infer an empirical or real-world probability.
